content:
I can read and understand text in many languages—dozens of major ones, including:

- English
- Spanish
- French
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Dutch
- Russian
- Ukrainian
- Polish
- Arabic
- Hebrew
- Hindi
- Bengali
- Urdu
- Chinese
- Japanese
- Korean
- Vietnamese
- Thai
- Turkish
- Greek
- Latin

I’m strongest in widely used languages with lots of available text, and less reliable with rare languages, dialects, highly informal writing, or poorly scanned/garbled text.
